test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The judge decided that / the defendant was guilty of all charges, / and that a punishment of five years / in prison were appropriate.

options.text: the defendant was guilty of all charges,
and that a punishment of five years

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in option 2 is the use of **"were"** which should be **"was" **because the subject **"a punishment of five years" **is singular.
 
• Verb will be as per the subject **‘a punishment’ **to ensure verb-subject agreement.

Therefore, the correct sentence is-** *"The judge decided that the defendant was guilty of all charges, and that a punishment of five years in prison was appropriate."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 ("the defendant was guilty of all charges,") **is grammatically correct because it correctly states the decision made about the defendant.
 
• **Option 3 ("and that a punishment of five years") **correctly connects two clauses with "and" and introduces the second decision.
 
• **Option 4 ("The judge decided that")** appropriately sets the scene for the actions decided by the judge.
